BAN_BEG_004: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM accounts;
BAN_BEG_005: SELECT * FROM accounts ORDER BY balance DESC;
BAN_BEG_006: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM account_products ORDER BY category;
BAN_BEG_007: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE open_date >= DATE '2026-01-01';
BAN_BEG_009: SELECT * FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT 5;
BAN_BEG_010: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE balance BETWEEN 25000 AND 75000;
BAN_BEG_011: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE customer_name LIKE 'A%';
BAN_BEG_012: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE status IN ('Active','Pending');
BAN_BEG_014: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30';
BAN_BEG_015: SELECT AVG(balance) AS average_amount FROM accounts;
BAN_BEG_016: SELECT MAX(amount) AS largest_amount FROM transactions;
BAN_BEG_017: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count FROM customers;
BAN_BEG_019: SELECT account_id, balance, CASE WHEN balance >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN balance >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_band FROM accounts ORDER BY account_id;
BAN_BEG_020: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE status = 'Active' AND balance >= 50000;
BAN_INT_001: SELECT m.customer_name, r.account_id, r.status, r.balance FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id ORDER BY m.customer_id,r.account_id;
BAN_INT_002: SELECT c.product_name, COUNT(r.account_id) AS record_count FROM account_products c LEFT JOIN accounts r ON c.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY c.product_id,c.product_name ORDER BY c.product_id;
BAN_INT_003: SELECT r.account_id FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id WHERE e.transaction_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_INT_004: SELECT r.account_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) AS total_amount FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_INT_005: SELECT r.account_id, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM accounts r JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id HAVING SUM(e.amount)>20000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
BAN_INT_006: SELECT m.segment, COUNT(r.account_id) AS record_count FROM customers m LEFT JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.segment ORDER BY m.segment;
BAN_INT_007: SELECT c.category, AVG(r.balance) AS average_amount FROM account_products c JOIN accounts r ON c.product_id=r.product_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
BAN_INT_008: SELECT m.customer_name, r.account_id, c.product_name, r.status FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id JOIN account_products c ON r.product_id=c.product_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_INT_009: SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name,SUM(r.balance) AS total_amount FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.customer_id,m.customer_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
BAN_INT_010: SELECT account_id,balance FROM accounts WHERE balance>(SELECT AVG(balance) FROM accounts) ORDER BY balance DESC;
BAN_INT_011: SELECT e.transaction_id,e.transaction_date,e.transaction_type,e.amount,r.status AS record_status FROM transactions e JOIN accounts r ON e.account_id=r.account_id ORDER BY e.transaction_id;
BAN_INT_012: SELECT r.account_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_INT_013: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',transaction_date)::date AS event_month,COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM transactions GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',transaction_date) ORDER BY event_month;
BAN_INT_014: SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name FROM customers m LEFT JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id WHERE r.account_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.customer_id;
BAN_INT_015: SELECT c.product_id,c.product_name FROM account_products c LEFT JOIN accounts r ON c.product_id=r.product_id WHERE r.account_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.product_id;
BAN_INT_016: SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name,MIN(r.open_date) AS first_date FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.customer_id,m.customer_name ORDER BY m.customer_id;
BAN_INT_017: SELECT r.account_id,MAX(e.transaction_date) AS latest_event_date FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_INT_018: SELECT DISTINCT m.customer_id,m.customer_name FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id WHERE e.status='Completed' ORDER BY m.customer_id;
BAN_INT_019: SELECT c.category,AVG(e.amount) AS average_event_amount FROM account_products c JOIN accounts r ON c.product_id=r.product_id JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
BAN_INT_020: SELECT m.segment,r.status,COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.segment,r.status ORDER BY m.segment,r.status;
BAN_EXP_001: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name,SUM(e.amount) total_amount FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY m.customer_id,m.customer_name) SELECT customer_id,customer_name,total_amount,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM totals ORDER BY amount_rank,customer_id;
BAN_EXP_002: SELECT r.account_id,MAX(e.transaction_date) AS latest_event_date FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id HAVING MAX(e.transaction_date)<DATE '2026-01-01' OR MAX(e.transaction_date) IS NULL ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_EXP_003: WITH totals AS (SELECT customer_id,SUM(balance) total_amount FROM accounts GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id,total_amount FROM totals WHERE total_amount>(SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
BAN_EXP_004: SELECT account_id,balance,CASE WHEN balance>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN balance>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM accounts ORDER BY account_id;
BAN_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT account_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',transaction_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY account_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',transaction_date)) SELECT account_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY account_id,event_month;
BAN_EXP_006: SELECT account_id,transaction_id,transaction_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_date,transaction_id) running_amount FROM transactions ORDER BY account_id,transaction_date,transaction_id;
BAN_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount DESC,transaction_id) rn FROM transactions e) SELECT transaction_id,account_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY account_id,rn;
BAN_EXP_008: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.account_id,COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) total_amount FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id) SELECT account_id,total_amount,ROUND(100.0*total_amount/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER(),0),2) percent_of_total FROM totals ORDER BY account_id;
BAN_EXP_009: SELECT customer_id,account_id,balance,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance DESC) amount_rank FROM accounts ORDER BY customer_id,amount_rank,account_id;
BAN_EXP_010: SELECT account_id,transaction_id,transaction_date,amount,LAG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_date,transaction_id) previous_amount FROM transactions ORDER BY account_id,transaction_date,transaction_id;
BAN_EXP_011: SELECT account_id,transaction_id,transaction_date,amount,AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_date,transaction_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) moving_average FROM transactions ORDER BY account_id,transaction_date,transaction_id;
BAN_EXP_012: SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name FROM customers m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts r WHERE r.customer_id=m.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts r WHERE r.customer_id=m.customer_id AND r.status<>'Active') ORDER BY m.customer_id;
BAN_EXP_013: SELECT account_id,status,balance FROM accounts r WHERE balance>(SELECT AVG(x.balance) FROM accounts x WHERE x.status=r.status) ORDER BY status,balance DESC;
BAN_EXP_014: SELECT r.account_id,MIN(e.transaction_date) first_event,MAX(e.transaction_date) last_event,MAX(e.transaction_date)-MIN(e.transaction_date) active_days FROM accounts r JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_EXP_015: SELECT transaction_id,account_id,amount,ROUND(100.0*amount/NULLIF(SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id),0),2) record_percent FROM transactions ORDER BY account_id,transaction_id;
BAN_EXP_016: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name,m.segment,SUM(r.balance) total_amount FROM customers m JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.customer_id,m.customer_name,m.segment), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amount DESC,customer_id) rn FROM totals) SELECT customer_id,customer_name,segment,total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY segment;
BAN_EXP_017: SELECT transaction_id,account_id,amount FROM transactions e WHERE amount>(SELECT AVG(x.amount) FROM transactions x WHERE x.account_id=e.account_id) ORDER BY account_id,amount DESC;
BAN_EXP_018: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.customer_id,m.customer_name,COUNT(r.account_id) record_count FROM customers m LEFT JOIN accounts r ON m.customer_id=r.customer_id GROUP BY m.customer_id,m.customer_name) SELECT customer_id,customer_name,record_count FROM counts WHERE record_count>(SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts) ORDER BY record_count DESC,customer_id;
BAN_EXP_019: SELECT r.account_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Pending' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) pending_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) failed_amount FROM accounts r LEFT JOIN transactions e ON r.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY r.account_id ORDER BY r.account_id;
BAN_EXP_020: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_date DESC,transaction_id DESC) rn FROM transactions e) SELECT transaction_id,account_id,transaction_date,transaction_type,amount,status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY account_id;
